# Transporeon: Transport Operations API

- **Product:** Transporeon: Transport Operations API (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** HTTP basic. Declared security schemes: basic.
- **Access:** Transporeon Transport Operations customers.
- **To call it you would need:** Transporeon Transport Operations credentials for api.transporeon.com/operations.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.transporeon.com/operations`, `https://api.test.transporeon.com/operations`.
- **Definitions:** 3, one section each below.
